---
title: "Read the edition before it leaves the workspace"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
manual:
  page: 14
---

This is the point at which editorial judgment belongs. The checks below catch
structural problems; they do not decide whether an item deserves space in the
newsletter.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm there is a candidate to review"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
test -s intermediate.md
test -s params.yml
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Review the publication view"}

Read `intermediate.md` from beginning to end. Check the title, date, section
order, images, alt text, links, dates, and the tone of the issue. Resolve any
missing or stale material in the source files, then repeat composition.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Run the layout audit"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
./diagnose_newsletter_layout.sh intermediate.md \\
  _data/newsletter/events-opportunities.yml
```

The audit catches long URLs being used as visible link text and reports raw
fixed-width elements for narrow-viewport review. It is a source-handoff check;
the final Jekyll page still needs browser inspection when the site environment
is available.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Inspect the proposed changes"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
git diff --check
git status --short -- params.yml template.qmd Newsletter_Preproc.qmd \
  _headline.md _conference.md _execupdate.md _scupdate.md _orgmember.md \
  _communityfunds.md _news.md _events.md _reads.md _involved.md _jobs.md
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="The edition is approved for handoff"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
test -s intermediate.md
test -s params.yml
! rg -n 'TODO|TBD|PLACEHOLDER|Newsletter_Helpers' intermediate.md params.yml
! rg -n --pcre2 '\[(?:https?://)[^\]]{80,}\]\(https?://' intermediate.md \\
  _data/newsletter/events-opportunities.yml
git diff --check
```

The human reviewer should also confirm that the edition is ready to emit before
continuing.

:::
